name: TagInput
description: The TagInput component provides an interactive, accessible way to select and create tags from a predefined list of options.
usage: Use TagInput when users need to select multiple tags from a predefined list
Controlled with value (the selected ids) and onChange(ids); uncontrolled with defaultValue. selectedTags is the deprecated name for value
Allow users to create new tags by providing the onCreateTag handler
An error shows at once; pass touched to hold it until the field is left (touched={false} hides it)
Limit the number of tags that can be selected using maxTags prop
Keyboard: type to filter, ArrowDown/ArrowUp move through the suggestions (wrapping), Enter adds the active one or the typed name (without submitting a form), Escape closes the suggestions
Tag suggestions show up to 5 relevant suggestions as you type
Helper text is displayed below the input (not shown when error is displayed)
Sizes: 'xs' (smaller type and padding) and 'md' (default); compact is the deprecated alias for 'xs'
examples:
<TagInput
  id="skills"
  label="Skills"
  availableTags={availableSkills}
  value={selectedSkills}
  onChange={setSelectedSkills}
  onCreateTag={async (tagName) => {
    // API call to create a new tag
    const response = await fetch('/api/skills', {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({ name: tagName }),
    });
    const newSkill = await response.json();
    return newSkill; // Should return { id: string, name: string }
  }}
  helperText="Select skills or create new ones by typing and pressing Enter"
/>

<TagInput
  id="topics"
  label="Topics"
  availableTags={availableTopics}
  value={selectedTopics}
  onChange={setSelectedTopics}
  error="At least one topic is required"
  touched={hasSubmitted}
  required
/>

<TagInput
  id="keywords"
  label="Keywords"
  availableTags={availableKeywords}
  value={selectedKeywords}
  onChange={setSelectedKeywords}
  maxTags={5}
  helperText="Select up to 5 keywords"
/>
design: Loading state shows spinner with 'Loading tags...' message
Tag suggestions are limited to 5 items to prevent overwhelming the user
Selected tags display with Tag component and remove button (X icon)
Create new tag button appears when onCreateTag handler is provided and input doesn't match existing tags
Maximum tags limit visually prevents adding more tags and hides input when reached
A text field: the box shows focus however it came (border and ring-1 in --color-primary; --color-error with an error)
Error state: --color-error border and the message below; disabled shows the helper instead
The active suggestion takes the hover background (--color-surface-3)
accessibility: The text field is a combobox (aria-autocomplete=list, aria-expanded, aria-controls) over a listbox of options; aria-activedescendant follows the arrow keys
Labelled with <label htmlFor>; without label, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby
A shown error sets aria-invalid and aria-describedby (the helper's id otherwise); an app's aria-describedby is kept
Escape that closes the suggestions is claimed (preventDefault), so a dialog around it stays open
Remove tag buttons have aria-label describing the action and a keyboard ring
Required fields indicated with visual asterisk and the required attribute while no tag is chosen

props.name: id
props.description: The text field's id; generated with useId() when left out

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Without it, pass aria-label or aria-labelledby

props.name: availableTags
props.description: Array of all available tags ({ id, name })

props.name: value
props.description: The selected tag ids (controlled). Leave out for uncontrolled

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The ids selected at first, when value is left out

props.name: selectedTags
props.description: Deprecated: use value

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the whole new id list when a tag is added or removed (value-first)

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows 'Loading tags...' and disables the field

props.name: disabled
props.description: Native disabled on the field and every remove button

props.name: onCreateTag
props.description: Creates a tag from the typed name (Enter, or the Create button)

props.name: error
props.description: Error message; shown unless touched is false or the field is disabled

props.name: touched
props.description: Leave out to show error at once; pass the field's touched state to hold it until the field is left (false hides it)

props.name: helperText
props.description: Helper text below the field (the error replaces it)

props.name: className
props.description: Merged with cn on the root; the app's class wins

props.name: required
props.description: Asterisk, and the required attribute while no tag is chosen

props.name: maxTags
props.description: Maximum number of tags; the text field goes away when it is reached (and the ref with it)

props.name: size
props.description: xs: smaller type, padding, tags and buttons

props.name: compact
props.description: Deprecated: use size="xs". size wins when both are given

props.name: ref
props.description: The native text input (the combobox)

props.name: ...rest
props.description: Every other prop (name, aria-*, data-*, onKeyDown, onFocus, onBlur, placeholder…) goes to the input. The app's onKeyDown runs first; preventDefault there skips the component's keys
